title: Modernized Sheep
description: Just a simple texture pack to make the texture and model of sheep a bit better.
body:
Retextures and remodels the sheep because I think the Minecraft sheep lowkenuinely looks ugly so I made it better, I think, I guess that's subjective, this pack was also based on the Mixed Litter mod idk if its a library mod or also adds the textures i just saw the sheep in the gallery and was like mm i like that. I'm not the craziest texture artist but I tried to lock in on this one so enjoy.

Oh and if it wasnt obvious you'll need Optifine or Entity Model Features
